# Teledisk regression disks

`normal.td0` and `advanced.td0` are synthetic disks generated by
`../../tools/generate_teledisk_fixture.py` (GPL-3.0-or-later, BogDan Vatra, 2026).
They encode identical sector bytes. The advanced stream exercises literal and
LZSS codes, overlapping dictionary copies, dictionary wrapping, and adaptive
Huffman tree reconstruction. They contain no third-party operating system.

The Teledisk parser follows Dave Dunfield's *Teledisk .TD0 notes* (2008) and
Will Krantz's format analysis:
https://github.com/jmechnich/wteledsk/blob/master/doc/wteledsk.htm
The LZHUF algorithm was developed by Haruhiko Okumura and Haruyasu Yoshizaki
(1988–1989). ZxKit's reader owns its state per image; it uses no mutable globals.
